open_obligations.what_is_open: Whether the compact rational circuits \(g_E\), for \(E\in\mathcal R(C)\), can be partitioned under global identity on \(\mathbb S^p_{++}\) by a deterministic algorithm whose total time is polynomial in the input plus the complete explicit output encoding, or whose delay is polynomial between complete class records, with all member lists, exact class certificates, and requested shortest reversal certificates charged to that output.
open_obligations.obstruction: Positive-denominator clearing reduces equality to multivariate polynomial identity. Full expansion gives a deterministic certificate but can have exponential intermediate size and cancellation relative to the compact circuits and the final class records. Charging all memberships and certificates removes the earlier hidden-output defect, but the frozen core still supplies no deterministic output-sensitive canonical form or identity method controlling this intermediate blow-up.
open_obligations.attempted: The canonical background-PDAG algorithm closes exact-once state enumeration, path-independent lifting, and shortest legal-reversal certificates. For each pair of compact effect circuits, positive denominators were cleared and numerator coefficient tables were expanded, yielding an exact terminating global-identity test and a finite exhaustive quotient. This proves correctness and termination but not the revised output-sensitive bound.

prose_updates.tldr: Equal incoming coefficients encode communities of direct causes. On the published singleton-permitting blocked class, equality of full positive-definite covariance models is characterized by common skeleton and unshielded colliders, common repeated parent blocks, and fixed orientation across unequal endpoint block families; equivalently, states are linked by partition-compatible singleton covered reversals. The canonical CPDAG-plus-background-arrow representation yields exact-once state enumeration after \(O(p^3)\) initialization with \(O(p+m)\) delay, output-linear partition lifting, a sharp \(p!\) bound, generic fixed-\(p\) BIC component recovery, and simultaneous inference for the finite effect set. The remaining question asks for deterministic output-sensitive quotienting of compact rational effect circuits, with complete member lists, identity certificates, and requested shortest reversal certificates all charged to the explicit output size.

project_justification.fill: The project recovers repeated blocks from the identity tangent space, proves by an exact sparse regression separator that any reversed edge must join equal endpoint families, and combines these facts with monotone covered reversals to obtain the full static and transformational characterization. It then converts the class to a canonical background PDAG: every repeated-block arrow is background knowledge, every consistent extension has a unique path-independent partition lift, and the published linear-delay extension algorithm enumerates the blocked component exactly once. The same quotient supports generic fixed-dimensional BIC recovery and simultaneous possible-effect inference. The residual arithmetic-circuit question now measures time against the input plus complete explicit class records, including memberships, exact identity certificates, and requested shortest certificates.

prose_updates.related_work: BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026 is the writing and primary method anchor. Its Definition 5.14 defines blocked edge colourings without excluding singleton classes; properness is separate, and BPEC is the blocked, proper no-singleton subclass. Its Theorem 5.17 proves structural identifiability within BPEC, while Question 5.19 asks for a graphical characterization of edge-coloured model equivalence. The present result agrees with that boundary on the BPEC subclass and gives a complete equivalence characterization on the published blocked superclass; it does not transfer a BPEC converse to arbitrary cross-target colourings. Chickering1995 supplies the disagreement-decreasing sequence of distinct covered reversals, while the tangent and separator arguments prove those reversals legal for the coefficient partitions. WienobstLuttermannBannachLiskiewicz2023, Theorem 5, is used after forming the CPDAG-plus-\(F(C)\) PDAG: cubic Meek-closure initialization and linear-delay consistent-extension enumeration carry over through the canonical partition-lift bijection. That result does not quotient compact rational effect circuits or account for complete functional-class member lists and shortest certificates. Haughton1988 informs the finite smooth-model BIC argument. MaathuisKalischBuhlmann2009, ChangGuoMalinsky2026, and GuoPerkovic2022EfficientLS inform possible-effect estimation and inference but do not provide simultaneous inference over this full-model-equivalence component or deterministic output-sensitive rational-functional canonicalization.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The population component \(\mathcal R(C)\) is an equivalence class of complete covariance-model images, not the pointwise fibre of every state fitting one exceptional covariance. Zero edges and coincident coefficients can create additional pointwise representations outside the component. The set \(F(C)\) records orientations forced directly by unequal nonsingleton families, while collider, acyclicity, and Meek-closure constraints can compel further arrows; neither kind of compelled arrow alone identifies a numerical coefficient. Canonical PDAG enumeration is linear-delay in state outputs. Exact global rational identity is decidable by denominator clearing and coefficient expansion, but expansion can be exponentially larger than compact circuits and can undergo cancellation. No deterministic output-polynomial total-time or polynomial-delay guarantee is claimed for complete functional-class records, even though their member lists, exact certificates, and requested shortest paths are now included in the output-size measure.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The equivalence theorem concerns finite labelled causally sufficient linear Gaussian DAGs, target-local coefficient blocks, unrestricted real block coefficients, unrestricted positive target-specific innovation variances, and full positive-definite covariance images. It excludes cross-target edge colours, vertex-coloured innovation variances, latent confounding, selection, cycles, and pointwise supermodel fibres. State enumeration uses the canonical CPDAG-plus-\(F(C)\) PDAG, with \(O(p^3)\) initialization, \(O(p+m)\) delay, and output-linear partition lifting; attaching a shortest legal-reversal certificate has the safe \(O(p^5)\) per-output bound. The sharp state-count bound is \(p!\), attained by the complete all-singleton state. Exact quotienting of compact rational effect circuits is finite, but no deterministic output-sensitive bound is shown when complexity is measured against the input plus complete class records, including memberships and certificates. BIC recovery and confidence coverage are fixed-\(p\), pointwise, and generic away from a proper algebraic exceptional set; no greedy-search consistency or uniform inference near model intersections is asserted.
